paragraphs: i-PRO sells video security devices and AI-powered analytics that turn video data into precise, actionable insights. The page claims 60+ years of work on intelligent edge devices. The camera range listed includes 360-degree Fisheye cameras. Other listed product categories include a Network Video Recorder.

Camera analytics listed include AI Face/People/Vehicle detection. A featured item describes CV72-powered GenAI at the edge for free text detection and real-time alerts. Video Management Software is listed alongside the hardware.

Named deployments include Buffalo Public School District, which the site says improved security and simplified infrastructure with i-PRO cameras and recorders. Murietta Valley District Schools is cited for school safety with high-resolution i-PRO cameras. Pathway Church is cited for multi-campus safety and operations. A Grants and Contracts section is listed for the United States.
